## CIRCT is an ecosystem, not one IR {#circt-route}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="36%"}
[CIRCT](https://circt.llvm.org/) extends MLIR with an ecosystem for hardware:

- dialects at several abstraction levels;
- analyses, transformations, and conversions;
- import, simulation, verification, and export tools.

::: {.fragment}
Different projects follow different paths through this graph.

[Today, we need only a small part of it.]{.marker}
:::
:::

::: {.source-strip}

## The core dialects we need today {#circt-core}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="60%"}
- **`hw` - structure:** modules, ports, instances, and hardware types.

- **`comb` - logic:** pure combinational operations on bit vectors.

- **`seq` - time:** registers and other clocked state.

- **`sv` - SystemVerilog:** constructs needed while lowering and emitting RTL.
:::

::: {.column width="40%"}
These core dialects can coexist in the same design.

::: {.fragment}
The wider CIRCT ecosystem also models pipelines, scheduling, handshakes,
finite-state machines, services, simulation, and more.
:::

::: {.fragment}
[Next, we will play with CIRCT through its tools.]{.marker}
